description: The chats you are in, the most recently written to first: direct chats with one colleague ('with'), groups ('title', 'members', who is an administrator), each project's own chat ('project' — everybody who may open the project is in it), chats with an agent ('agents'). Each says how many messages you have not read ('unread'), up to which message you have read ('readUpTo'), whether you muted it, and its last message. With projectKey, just that project's chat. Read a chat with get_chat_messages; write with send_chat_message.

projectKey.description: A project's key: only that project's own chat — refused when you may not open the project.
